dateAssessment: YAML records June 13–14, 1749. Session 123 alone supplies elapsed intervals but no usable civil date or watch, and does not establish the recorded date transition; its transcript-only YAML assessment remains compatible, with incomplete coverage. The Feywild row retains only elapsed evidence. Supplementary Session 124 explicitly resumes the same return to Vindristjarna above Pava and Avaras’ house (u0001–u0003, u0063–u0064), corrects afternoon to morning (u0093–u0097), and specifies mid-morning while confirming that play starts just as the party arrived (u0229–u0232). The separate morning watch is therefore inferred retrospectively for the closing ship return; it supplies no civil date or preceding Feywild watch. The moon necklace’s weeks and sleeps concern the whole earlier Feywild journey.
